about_the_game:
Game Description:

 

When toilet signs are harder to decipher than Morse codes, your bladder is the last compass! You'll play as the Reborn and complete the most modest survival challenge in an infinitely looping toilet maze – finding a door that allows your gender to enter.

 

 

Core gameplay

 

Each start randomly receives:

period:Tramp in office/Biiden in office

chromosome:from xxxxxxxx to yyyyyyyy

gender identity:97 Official Options + Memes(gunship/wallmart bag/Hideyoshi...)

what's new:self-recognition as a monkey/determined to be the great Cthulhu...

 

Confusing toilet signage system that keeps pace with the times

 

Choose the right door to enter, and if not, turn back immediately – just like all other anomaly games.

The characters, locations and elements involved in the game are purely fictitious and any similarities are coincidental.

Comprehensively judge the character information obtained randomly each time, choose the toilet that can be entered, and if not, immediately retreat!
